text:
elaine: Noticed several trials moved to 'stalled' without triggering the auto-reassign playbook during last night's bulk import.

devon: saw it too. Import job peaked and our playbook queue showed many "pending" tasks. No reject logs though.

elaine: audit lines show the playbook evaluated them but skipped action: `skip reason=claim_window_concurrency`. Weird.

rajesh: sounds like contention on the claim lock. We recently tightened the claim window to prevent thrash. Could be blocking fallback runs.

devon: workaround idea: have a lightweight 'reaper' consumer that looks for trials stuck >8h and issues a no-op-timestamp update to force re-eval. Low risk.

elaine: good interim. CS needs visibility too — add a console tag when reaper touches an account and a CSV export for renewal owners.

rajesh: will prototype reaper: poll where state=stalled and last_touch < now()-8h, push to low-priority claims topic with metadata {reaper:true, origin:job_id}. Dedupe by origin.

devon: also schedule a tuning change: relax claim_window_concurrency from 60s -> 30s during off-peak and monitor collision rate.

ops-bot: plan created: reaper/shortterm -> staging deploy at 2026-04-01T02:15:00Z by rajesh

elaine: assigning follow-ups: rajesh (reaper), devon (claim-window A/B), i'll own export for renewals. Will run manual nudge for the 5 affected accounts now.

rajesh: putting a short doc in the ticket about expected behaviour and rollback steps.

elaine: thanks team. We'll retro after deploy. :thumbsup:
